RAMP REACHES $60B VALUATION AS IT PUSHES DEEPER INTO AI
articles.summary: Ramp raised $1.85 billion at a $60 billion valuation, up from $44 billion just four months earlier, as annualized revenue surpassed $2 billion and annualized purchase volume reached more than $275 billion. The company is expanding well beyond expense management into payments, accounting, procurement, and AI infrastructure, including model routing, token spend management, agentic cards, and Glass, positioning itself as a broader financial and AI operating platform.

articles.title: MERCURY LETS AI AGENTS MOVE MONEY THROUGH MCP WITH USER APPROVAL
articles.summary: Mercury expanded its MCP from read-only account access to financial actions, allowing users to ask ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents to move money, pay vendors, and categorize transactions directly from chat. Agents can prepare actions, but Mercury keeps a human approval step before transfers are completed, combining agentic workflows with account-level controls and revocable access.

articles.title: AMEX WILL PAY FOR AGENT ERRORS, EXCEPT IN THE CASES AGENTS ACTUALLY GET WRONG
articles.summary: Amex calls Agent Purchase Protection an industry-first commitment to cover Card Member losses from a registered agent's purchase error, for the full transaction amount plus other reasonable charges directly incurred. It is the first time a major issuer has put its name to the liability question agentic commerce has been dodging.

articles.title: STRIPE SAYS AGENTIC COMMERCE ACTIVITY WENT “VERTICAL” IN SEPTEMBER
articles.summary: Stripe President John Collison says agent-driven commerce on Stripe began accelerating sharply in September, suggesting AI agents are starting to move from product discovery into actual purchasing. He argues that computer use was a key unlock because agents can now navigate existing websites and complete purchases without native integrations, while payments companies still need to solve issues such as authorization, liability, and merchant acceptance.

articles.title: WINNING THE RELAY RACE: LONG-RUNNING AGENTS IN HIGH-VALUE CUSTOMER JOURNEYS
articles.summary: The next major AI opportunity is “long-running agents” that own complex customer journeys across weeks or months, rather than completing isolated tasks. By maintaining context, coordinating sub-agents, and learning from each case, these systems could capture value that currently leaks across human handoffs and let vendors price against outcomes or revenue uplift, with go-to-market models ranging from software platforms to outsourced services to fully integrated AI-native businesses.

articles.title: PATRICK COLLISON SAYS PRIVY HAS SCALED RAPIDLY INSIDE STRIPE
articles.summary: Patrick Collison says Privy has grown sharply since Stripe acquired it, with assets in wallets up about 25x, monthly active developers up 3x, revenue up 9x, and transaction volume approaching $25 billion per month. Stripe is now integrating Privy across Treasury, Link, and Connect while combining it with Bridge, fiat rails, cards, and stablecoins to build a programmable financial stack for both businesses and AI agents.

articles.title: MASTERCARD AND BVNK LAUNCH GLOBAL MONEY PLATFORM FOR FIAT AND STABLECOINS
articles.summary: Mastercard and BVNK launched Global Money Platform, a single API that combines multi-currency fiat and stablecoin accounts, real-time conversion, stablecoin-linked cards, and local bank payouts through Mastercard Move. The platform is designed to let banks, fintechs, and enterprises manage and embed global money movement from one infrastructure layer, with future support planned for agentic commerce and additional regulated forms of money such as tokenized deposits.

articles.title: VISA DIRECT MOVES STABLECOIN-POWERED MONEY MOVEMENT FROM PILOT TO PRODUCTION
articles.summary: Visa is moving stablecoin capabilities in Visa Direct into commercial production, with Inyo Global becoming the first partner to enable businesses to prefund cross-border payouts using USDC in near real time. The launch lets fintechs, money transmitters, and payment companies use stablecoins for 24/7 liquidity and funding while still relying on Visa Direct's existing global payout network, marking a shift from stablecoin experimentation toward day-to-day payments infrastructure.

articles.title: GI PARTNERS CEO LEAVES AFTER A YEAR, DELAYING FUND VII PLANS
articles.summary: GI Partners CEO and head of private equity Travis Pearson left the $49 billion firm after just over a year in the role, prompting GI to reconsider the timing of its seventh private equity fund and push the launch into 2027. The firm does not plan to name a new CEO, instead relying on its executive committee while three senior investors co-lead the private equity business.

articles.title: AI-NATIVE PAYMENTS PLATFORM MOVERE LAUNCHES
articles.summary: A collection of banking and fintech veterans has unveiled Movere, an AI-native payments platform for businesses.

articles.title: STRIPE AND PLASMA TEAM ON MULTI-CURRENCY STABLECOIN CARDS
articles.summary: Stripe and Plasma today announced a collaboration to launch multi-currency stablecoin cards, making it easier for people and businesses to spend across currencies and markets.
